snippet.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Your great journey begins today. 

After crash landing on a mysterious ringworld known as Halo, the Master Chief is tasked with defending humanity against an overwhelming alien force: the Covenant. With the help of his AI companion Cortana, the Chief must uncover Halo’s dark secrets and fight to avert the annihilation of all life in the galaxy.

Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign, rebuilt from the ground up with high-definition visuals, refined controls, 2-player splitscreen co-op on console, and up to 4-player online cross-platform co-op on console and pc. Enjoy 3 new missions, an expanded arsenal of weapons and vehicles, endless replayability with 42 gameplay modifying Skulls, Campaign Remix, and more.

Halo: Campaign Evolved is available on XBOX Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation® 5.

Buy now! http://aka.ms/HCEBuyNow
